rules: No real-money ticket, system, multiple, reduced system or portfolio may exceed 15 EUR for one game/draw.
Prefer 10 EUR or less when comparable expected coverage is available.
If a research-optimal system costs more than 15 EUR, keep the full system in SHADOW and generate a budget-constrained playable version at or below 15 EUR.
Never increase stake to chase losses.
The cap may only be reviewed after realised winnings increase the bankroll; no automatic increase is allowed.

quiniela.playablePolicy: Optimise signs/doubles/triples under the hard 15 EUR cap; never recommend the 216-column direct development for real money.
